        registration_system = ClassRegistrationSystem()

import unittest


class AgentTest_get_all_major(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_get_all_major_1(self):
        # An empty system has no students, so there are no majors.
        registration_system = ClassRegistrationSystem()
        result = registration_system.get_all_major()
        self.assertIsInstance(result, list)
        self.assertEqual(result, [])

    def test_get_all_major_2(self):
        # Example from the docstring: one student with one major.
        registration_system = ClassRegistrationSystem()
        registration_system.students = [{"name": "John", "major": "Computer Science"}]
        result = registration_system.get_all_major()
        self.assertEqual(result, ["Computer Science"])

    def test_get_all_major_3(self):
        # Students with different majors: every major is returned.
        registration_system = ClassRegistrationSystem()
        registration_system.students = [
            {"name": "John", "major": "Computer Science"},
            {"name": "Alice", "major": "Mathematics"},
            {"name": "Bob", "major": "Physics"},
        ]
        result = registration_system.get_all_major()
        self.assertIsInstance(result, list)
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"Computer Science", "Mathematics", "Physics"})

    def test_get_all_major_4(self):
        # Majors registered through register_student appear in the result.
        registration_system = ClassRegistrationSystem()
        registration_system.register_student({"name": "John", "major": "Computer Science"})
        registration_system.register_student({"name": "Alice", "major": "Mathematics"})
        result = registration_system.get_all_major()
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"Computer Science", "Mathematics"})

    def test_get_all_major_5(self):
        # Majors come from the students' major field, not from student names
        # or from the class registrations.
        registration_system = ClassRegistrationSystem()
        registration_system.students = [
            {"name": "John", "major": "Computer Science"},
            {"name": "Alice", "major": "Mathematics"},
        ]
        registration_system.students_registration_classes = {
            "John": ["CS101", "CS102"],
            "Alice": ["MA101"],
        }
        result = registration_system.get_all_major()
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"Computer Science", "Mathematics"})
        self.assertNotIn("John", result)
        self.assertNotIn("Alice", result)
        self.assertNotIn("CS101", result)
        self.assertNotIn("MA101", result)

                                        {"name": "B", "major": "Computer Science"},
                                        {"name": "C", "major": "Computer Science"}]

            "A": ["Algorithms", "Data Structures"],
            "B": ["Data Structures", "Operating Systems"],

            registration_system.get_most_popular_class_in_major("Computer Science"),
            "Data Structures"
        )

        # Enrollments from students in other majors must not be counted
        registration_system = ClassRegistrationSystem()
        registration_system.students = [{"name": "A", "major": "Computer Science"},
                                        {"name": "M1", "major": "Mathematics"},
                                        {"name": "M2", "major": "Mathematics"},

        registration_system.students_registration_classes = {
            "A": ["Algorithms"],
            "M1": ["Calculus"],

        }
        self.assertEqual(
            registration_system.get_most_popular_class_in_major("Computer Science"),
            "Algorithms"
        )
